entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-23
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Add Microsoft Learn links to LSP hover #86601
  • Type parameter inference from constraints makes services.AddSingleton(sp => ...) ambiguous (CS0121) under LangVersion=preview #86599
  • Ensure analyzer config files are location-independent #86593
    18.15
  • MSBuildWorkspace does not trim the entries of `TargetFrameworks` #86592
  • Find References misses a cref in a documentation comment preceded by a comment that mentions the name #86591
  • NullReferenceException when binding a cref in the documentation comment of a nested enum declared without body (`enum E;`) #86589
    18.15

Closed

  • Type inference dependency tracking through tuples and collection expressions is missing #86507
    18.14
  • `GetAsyncIterationType` incorrectly returns a synchronous iteration type for arrays #86339
  • [AI artifact audit] Weekly AI guidance hygiene findings #86594
  • IDE0320 not enabled when dotnet_analyzer_diagnostic.severity = error #76222
    18.3
  • [AI artifact audit] AI artifact audit: obsolete MCP tool names in skill docs #86125

PullRequests

Created

  • Localized file check-in by OneLocBuild Task: Build definition ID 327: Build ID 3144277 #86598
    Area-Razor
  • Pick a file name that isn't in use when moving static members to a new type #86597
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Do not report IDE0100 when the comparison performs a user-defined implicit conversion to bool #86596
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Use Roslyn to format Razor tooltip documentation #86588
    Area-Razor

Merged

  • Properly track type argument inference dependencies from tuple literals and collection expressions #86557
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • fix GetAsyncIterationType for arrays #86340
    Area-Compilers, Community, VSCode, Next
  • Align AI guidance with repository behavior #86595
    Area-Razor, Next
  • Respect the configured severity for IDE0320 #86568
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode, Next

Updated

  • Use Key Vault signing for the PR tagger #86448
    Area-IDE, Community
  • Use managed ILAssembler in Roslyn tests #86546
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode
  • Respect analyzer filter changes in FSA diagnostic caching #86532
    Area-Analyzers, VSCode
  • Keep trailing trivia in sync when reusing syntax nodes #86582
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Avoid reusing interpolated string tokens after incremental edits #86578
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Avoid reusing constructors at Script root during incremental parsing #86576
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Don't offer IDE0370 for a suppression that makes a field-backed getter null-resilient #86580
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Don't offer IDE0340 when the unbound nameof wouldn't bind #86579
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • Remove the unsafe v2 stackalloc/SkipLocalsInit restriction #86294
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Align behavior of `SourceNamedTypeSymbol.ReduceExtensionMember` with `ReducedExtensionMethodSymbol.InferExtensionMethodTypeArguments` with respect to type argument handling #86563
    Area-Compilers
  • Avoid duplicating compiler response arguments in binlogs #85244
    Area-Compilers, Community
  • Use the formatting options' newline when inserting suppression pragmas #86514
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
  • [release/dev18.0] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #86370
    Area-Infrastructure
  • keep the As clause when removing it would change what the name binds to #86574
    Area-IDE, Community, VSCode
